authors: Jorge Jimenez, Jose I. Echevarria, Belen Masia, Fernando Navarro, Diego Gutierrez
obtained_via: https://github.com/steverice/visr/tree/5754170b18f39cbd5824330848cb0815fdd3a44e/port/third_party/smaa, which records that SMAA.hlsl is copied unchanged from the upstream commit above and that its area_tex.zlib and search_tex.zlib are the bytes of Textures/AreaTex.h and Textures/SearchTex.h compressed with zlib.

SMAA.hlsl.modified: Transcoded from Latin-1 to UTF-8 (two U+00B7 middle dots in the comment diagram at lines 53 and 63) for the repository's text-only source policy. No other change.

AreaTex.hex.content: AreaTex: 160x560, two channels (R8G8), 179200 bytes as hex text, one image row per line

SearchTex.hex.content: SearchTex: 64x16, one channel (R8), 1024 bytes as hex text, one image row per line

derived: native/EngineHost/smaa_msl.inc is generated from these files by tools/generate_smaa_msl.py (Metal Shading Language rewrite of the HLSL out/inout parameters and swizzled conditional moves, plus the lookup textures as raw DEFLATE). It keeps the MIT notice.
